title: Universal Life Insurance Reserve Standard: Deduction Reserve for Paid-Up Overloan Coverage
content:
Because coverage that becomes paid-up under overloan protection no longer collects monthly deductions, a deduction reserve is left out of the value on which the protected face of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is figured. It is taken off that value together with the overloan protection charge booked, before the value is multiplied into the protected face. The reserve follows the insured's attained age and the policy year on the exercise date.

## Reserve standard

| Insured's attained age on the exercise date | Policy year on the exercise date | Deduction reserve |
|---|---|---|
| **85** or over (the senior reserve age) | Any | **6** (the senior reserve months) times the current monthly deduction |
| Below 85 | Before policy year **25** (the reserve-end policy year) | The current monthly deduction for each monthly anniversary still to fall due after the exercise date up to and including the next policy anniversary |
| Below 85 | Policy year 25 or later | No reserve |

The current monthly deduction is the one shown on the policy record. Attained age is the insured's age last birthday. A monthly anniversary falling on the exercise date itself is not one still to fall due; the next policy anniversary is.

## Worked figures (hypothetical; current monthly deduction $850.00, issue date 10 April, monthly anniversaries on the 10th)

| Attained age | Policy year | Exercise date | Monthly anniversaries still to fall due | Reserve |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 86 | 18 | 20 June | not used | 6 times $850.00, $5100.00 |
| 85 | 27 | 20 June | not used | $5100.00 |
| 80 | 18 | 20 June | 10 (10 July through 10 April) | $8500.00 |
| 80 | 18 | 10 March | 1 (10 April) | $850.00 |
| 80 | 26 | 20 June | not used | none |

The age test is read first: an insured aged 85 or over leaves six months of deductions whatever the policy year.
